# Installation

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/README.md

A collection of runtime types and combinators for use with [io-ts](https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts)

# Installation

To install the stable version:

```sh
npm i io-ts-types
```

**Note**. `io-ts-types` depends on

- [`fp-ts`](https://github.com/gcanti/fp-ts)
- [`io-ts`](https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts)
- [`monocle-ts`](https://github.com/gcanti/monocle-ts)
- [`newtype-ts`](https://github.com/gcanti/newtype-ts)

starting from `0.5.0` you must install `fp-ts`, `io-ts`, `newtype-ts` and `monocle-ts` manually (`fp-ts`, `io-ts`, `newtype-ts` and `monocle-ts` are listed in `peerDependency`)

# TypeScript compatibility

| `io-ts-types` version | required `typescript` version |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| 0.5.x                 | 3.5+                          |
| 0.4.x                 | 3.1+                          |

# Documentation

- [API Reference](https://gcanti.github.io/io-ts-types)

# BigIntFromString overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/BigIntFromString.ts.md

title: BigIntFromString.ts
nav_order: 1

# BigIntFromString overview

Added in v0.5.11

- [BigIntFromStringC (interface)](#bigintfromstringc-interface)
- [BigIntFromString](#bigintfromstring)

# BigIntFromStringC (interface)

```ts
export interface BigIntFromStringC extends t.Type<bigint, string, unknown> {}
```

Added in v0.5.11

# BigIntFromString

```ts
export const BigIntFromString: BigIntFromStringC = ...
```

```ts
import { BigIntFromString } from 'io-ts-types/lib/BigIntFromString'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

assert.deepStrictEqual(BigIntFromString.decode('1'), right(BigInt(1)))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(BigIntFromString.decode('1.1')), [
  'Invalid value "1.1" supplied to : BigIntFromString'
])
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(BigIntFromString.decode('')), [
  'Invalid value "" supplied to : BigIntFromString'
])
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(BigIntFromString.decode(' ')), [
  'Invalid value " " supplied to : BigIntFromString'
])
```

Added in v0.5.11

```ts

```

Added in v0.5.13

# BooleanFromNumber

```ts
export const BooleanFromNumber: BooleanFromNumberC = ...
```

```ts
import { BooleanFromNumber } from 'io-ts-types/lib/BooleanFromNumber'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

assert.deepStrictEqual(BooleanFromNumber.decode(1), right(true))
assert.deepStrictEqual(BooleanFromNumber.decode(0), right(false))
assert.deepStrictEqual(BooleanFromNumber.decode(123), right(true))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(BooleanFromNumber.decode('a')), [
  'Invalid value "a" supplied to : BooleanFromNumber'
])
```

Added in v0.5.13

Returns a clone of the given codec

```ts
export function clone<C extends t.Any>(t: C): C { ... }
```

```ts
import { clone } from 'io-ts-types/lib/clone'
import * as t from 'io-ts'

assert.deepStrictEqual(clone(t.string), t.string)
```

# EitherC (interface)

```ts
export interface EitherC<L extends t.Mixed, R extends t.Mixed>
  extends t.Type<Either<t.TypeOf<L>, t.TypeOf<R>>, EitherOutput<t.OutputOf<L>, t.OutputOf<R>>, unknown> {}
```

Added in v0.5.0

# EitherOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type EitherOutput<L, R> = LeftOutput<L> | RightOutput<R>
```

Added in v0.5.18

# LeftOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type LeftOutput<L> = { _tag: 'Left'; left: L }
```

Added in v0.5.18

# RightOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type RightOutput<R> = { _tag: 'Right'; right: R }
```

Added in v0.5.18

# either

Given a codec representing a type `L` and a codec representing a type `A`, returns a codec representing `Either<L, A>` that is able to deserialize
the JSON representation of an `Either`.

```ts
export function either<L extends t.Mixed, R extends t.Mixed>(
  leftCodec: L,
  rightCodec: R,
  name: string = `Either<${leftCodec.name}, ${rightCodec.name}>`
): EitherC<L, R> { ... }
```

```ts
import { either } from 'io-ts-types/lib/either'
import { left, right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

const T = either(t.string, t.number)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(right(1)), right(right(1)))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(left('a')), right(left('a')))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode(right('a'))), [
  'Invalid value "a" supplied to : Either<string, number>/1: Right<string>/right: number'
])
```

Added in v0.5.0

# fromNewtype overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/fromNewtype.ts.md

title: fromNewtype.ts
nav_order: 10

# fromNewtype overview

Added in v0.5.2

- [fromNewtype](#fromnewtype)

# fromNewtype

Returns a codec from a newtype

```ts
export function fromNewtype<N extends AnyNewtype = never>(
  codec: t.Type<CarrierOf<N>, t.OutputOf<CarrierOf<N>>>,
  name = `fromNewtype(${codec.name})`
): t.Type<N, CarrierOf<N>, unknown> { ... }
```

```ts
import { fromNewtype } from 'io-ts-types/lib/fromNewtype'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'
import { Newtype, iso } from 'newtype-ts'

interface Token extends Newtype<{ readonly Token: unique symbol }, string> {}

const T = fromNewtype<Token>(t.string)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode('sometoken'), right(iso<Token>().wrap('sometoken')))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode(42)), ['Invalid value 42 supplied to : fromNewtype(string)'])
```

Added in v0.5.2

---

# fromNullable overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/fromNullable.ts.md

title: fromNullable.ts
nav_order: 11

# fromNullable overview

Added in v0.5.0

- [fromNullable](#fromnullable)

# fromNullable

Returns a clone of the given codec that replace a nullable input with the given value `a`

```ts
export function fromNullable<C extends t.Mixed>(codec: C, a: t.TypeOf<C>, name = `fromNullable(${codec.name})`): C { ... }
```

```ts
import { fromNullable } from 'io-ts-types/lib/fromNullable'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

const T = fromNullable(t.number, -1)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(1), right(1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(null), right(-1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(undefined), right(-1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode('a')), ['Invalid value "a" supplied to : fromNullable(number)'])
```

Added in v0.5.0

# getLenses overview

Added in v0.5.0

- [ExactHasLenses (interface)](#exacthaslenses-interface)
- [HasLenses (type alias)](#haslenses-type-alias)
- [getLenses](#getlenses)

# ExactHasLenses (interface)

```ts
export interface ExactHasLenses extends t.ExactType<HasLenses> {}
```

Added in v0.5.0

# HasLenses (type alias)

```ts
export type HasLenses = t.InterfaceType<any> | ExactHasLenses
```

Added in v0.5.0

# getLenses

Return a `Lens` for each prop

```ts
export function getLenses<C extends HasLenses>(
  codec: C
): { [K in keyof t.TypeOf<C>]: Lens<t.TypeOf<C>, t.TypeOf<C>[K]> } { ... }
```

```ts
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { getLenses } from 'io-ts-types/lib/getLenses'

const Person = t.type({
  name: t.string,
  age: t.number
})

const lenses = getLenses(Person)
assert.strictEqual(lenses.age.get({ name: 'Giulio', age: 44 }), 44)
```

Added in v0.5.0

# mapOutput overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/mapOutput.ts.md

title: mapOutput.ts
nav_order: 18

# mapOutput overview

Added in v0.3.2

- [mapOutput](#mapoutput)

# mapOutput

Changes the output type of the given runtime type

```ts
export function mapOutput<A, O, I, P>(
  codec: t.Type<A, O, I>,
  f: (p: O) => P,
  name: string = codec.name
): t.Type<A, P, I> { ... }
```

```ts
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { mapOutput } from 'io-ts-types/lib/mapOutput'
import { optionFromNullable } from 'io-ts-types/lib/optionFromNullable'
import { none, some } from 'fp-ts/lib/Option'

// Input: t.Type<Option<number>, number | null, t.mixed>
const Input = optionFromNullable(t.number)

const toUndefined = <A>(x: A | null): A | undefined => (x === null ? undefined : x)

// Output: t.Type<Option<number>, number | undefined, t.mixed>
const Output = mapOutput(Input, toUndefined)

assert.strictEqual(Output.encode(none), undefined)
assert.strictEqual(Output.encode(some(1)), 1)
```

Added in v0.3.2

Added in v0.5.0

- [SomeOutput (type alias)](#someoutput-type-alias)

# OptionC (interface)

Given a codec representing a type `A`, returns a codec representing `Option<A>` that is able to deserialize
the JSON representation of an `Option`.

```ts
export interface OptionC<C extends t.Mixed> extends t.Type<Option<t.TypeOf<C>>, OptionOutput<t.OutputOf<C>>, unknown> {}
```

```ts
import { option } from 'io-ts-types/lib/option'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { none, some } from 'fp-ts/lib/Option'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

const T = option(t.number)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(none), right(none))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(some(1)), right(some(1)))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode(some('a'))), [
  'Invalid value "a" supplied to : Option<number>/1: Some<number>/value: number'
])
```

Added in v0.5.0

# NoneOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type NoneOutput = t.OutputOf<typeof None>
```

Added in v0.5.18

# OptionOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type OptionOutput<A> = NoneOutput | SomeOutput<A>
```

Added in v0.5.18

# SomeOutput (type alias)

```ts
export type SomeOutput<A> = { _tag: 'Some'; value: A }
```

Added in v0.5.18

# option

```ts
export function option<C extends t.Mixed>(codec: C, name: string = `Option<${codec.name}>`): OptionC<C> { ... }
```

Added in v0.5.0

# optionFromNullable overview

Added in v0.5.0

- [OptionFromNullableC (interface)](#optionfromnullablec-interface)

# OptionFromNullableC (interface)

```ts
export interface OptionFromNullableC<C extends t.Mixed>
```

```ts
import { regexp } from 'io-ts-types/lib/regexp'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'

const input1 = /\w+/

assert.deepStrictEqual(regexp.decode(input1), right(input1))
```

```ts
export interface UUIDBrand {
  readonly UUID: unique symbol
}
```

Added in v0.4.6

# UUID (type alias)

```ts
export type UUID = t.Branded<string, UUIDBrand>
```

Added in v0.4.6

# UUID

```ts
export const UUID: t.BrandC<t.StringC, UUIDBrand> = ...
```

```ts
import { UUID } from 'io-ts-types/lib/UUID'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'

assert.deepStrictEqual(
  UUID.decode('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
  right('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
)
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(UUID.decode('not a uuid')), [
  'Invalid value "not a uuid" supplied to : UUID'
])
```

Added in v0.4.6

# withEncode overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/withEncode.ts.md

title: withEncode.ts
nav_order: 30

# withEncode overview

Added in v0.5.12

- [withEncode](#withencode)

# withEncode

Returns a clone of the given codec which uses the given `encode` function

```ts
export function withEncode<A, O, I, P>(
  codec: t.Type<A, O, I>,
  encode: (a: A) => P,
  name: string = codec.name
): t.Type<A, P, I> { ... }
```

```ts
import { withEncode } from 'io-ts-types/lib/withEncode'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'

const T = withEncode(t.number, String)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(1), right(1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.encode(1), '1')
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode('str')), ['Invalid value "str" supplied to : number'])
```

Added in v0.5.12

---

# withFallback overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/withFallback.ts.md

title: withFallback.ts
nav_order: 31

# withFallback overview

Added in v0.5.0

- [withFallback](#withfallback)

# withFallback

Returns a clone of the given codec that always succeed using the given value `a` if the original codec fails

```ts
export function withFallback<C extends t.Any>(codec: C, a: t.TypeOf<C>, name = `withFallback(${codec.name})`): C { ... }
```

```ts
import { withFallback } from 'io-ts-types/lib/withFallback'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'

const T = withFallback(t.number, -1)

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(1), right(1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode('a'), right(-1))
```

Added in v0.5.0

---

# withMessage overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/withMessage.ts.md

title: withMessage.ts
nav_order: 32

# withMessage overview

Added in v0.4.3

- [withMessage](#withmessage)

# withMessage

Returns a clone of the given codec that sets the given string as error messsage

```ts
export function withMessage<C extends t.Any>(codec: C, message: (i: t.InputOf<C>, c: t.Context) => string): C { ... }
```

```ts
import { withMessage } from 'io-ts-types/lib/withMessage'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'
import { right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'

const T = withMessage(t.number, () => 'Invalid number')

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(1), right(1))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode(null)), ['Invalid number'])
```

Added in v0.4.3

---

# withValidate overview

Source: https://github.com/gcanti/io-ts-types/blob/master/docs/modules/withValidate.ts.md

title: withValidate.ts
nav_order: 33

# withValidate overview

Added in v0.4.3

- [withValidate](#withvalidate)

# withValidate

Returns a clone of the given codec which uses the given `validate` function

```ts
export function withValidate<C extends t.Any>(codec: C, validate: C['validate'], name: string = codec.name): C { ... }
```

```ts
import { withValidate } from 'io-ts-types/lib/withValidate'
import * as t from 'io-ts'
import { PathReporter } from 'io-ts/lib/PathReporter'
import { either, right } from 'fp-ts/lib/Either'

const T = withValidate(t.number, (u, c) => either.map(t.number.validate(u, c), n => n * 2))

assert.deepStrictEqual(T.decode(1), right(2))
assert.deepStrictEqual(PathReporter.report(T.decode(null)), ['Invalid value null supplied to : number'])
```

Added in v0.4.3

---
